outcome: Quality of life (QOL) in various domains (physical functioning, role-limiting physical, pain, general health status)
cohort: 801 women who delivered at the maternity of the University of Campinas in Brazil
finding: Women who experienced severe maternal morbidity reported lower quality of life in physical functioning, role-limiting physical, pain, and general health status domains compared to women without SMM.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with worse perception of general health and quality of life.
